title: Shaped by Powder
caption:
The same pink can look different,
depending on its texture.

Powder blush is easy to build.
With a brush, you add a little at a time,
adjusting where it sits and how deep it looks.

Where it goes depends on the look.
But blended softly,
it brings natural shape to the face.

On humid days,
it also tends to stay where you put it.

You can layer it over a liquid blush, too.
Colour from within,
and shape on top.

So when you choose a colour,
choose the texture as well.
